description: This file defines utility classes for handling endianness-specific integer types, providing a safer way to work with values with specific byte orders, as an extension to android-base/endian.h.

classes.name: Le16
classes.description: A class representing a 16-bit little-endian unsigned integer.

methods.name: Le16(base_type val)
methods.description: Constructs Le16 from a uint16_t value, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: as_uint16_t()
methods.description: Returns the stored value as a uint16_t in host byte order.
